title: Agntshare Pathway Token Metadata Schema v1
description: Strict specification for Agntshare Pathway Token client-side metadata, access scopes, cryptographic provenance, and payload integrity checksums.

schema_version.description: Version of the Pathway Token specification.

framework.description: Originating AI agent framework (e.g. langchain, crewai, llamaindex, autogen, custom).

intent.description: Access scope intent granted to the pathway token holder.

ttl_seconds.description: Time-To-Live expiration window in seconds. Must be strictly greater than 0.

cryptographic_signature.description: Cryptographic signature produced by the originating client SDK for provenance verification.

payload_checksum.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 hash digest of the raw state/file payload.
